RESERVA CONCHAL

Through the Years

timeline_1

Bougainvillea

Exceeding all expectations of comfort, security and style, these 62 condominiums built in 2002 set the standard for single-family developments. They feature a Spanish colonial design, high ceilings and French doors with generously sized balconies facing the sea and the sunset. Named after the colorful flower, typically pink or magenta.

2002 | Residential

timeline_2
Melinas

2005 | Residential

Developed in 2005, Melinas offered buyers the
freedom to express their creativity in designing and building their private residences on a total of 12 lots with mountain and golf views. Named after the shady melina tree, whose flowers open during the night and typically fall to the ground within a day or two.

timeline_3
Malinche

2006 | Residential

The 27 Spanish colonial condominiums of Malinche, with a great selection of well-designed floor plans, command a hilltop position with panoramic views of the golf course and ocean views out to the Catalina Islands. Completed in 2006, these homes have a common swimming pool and are flanked by six luxury villas with 3 or 4 bedrooms, with private Jacuzzis and pools.

timeline_4
Carao

2007 | Residential

Five towers with six units (30 condos) and 12 luxury villas, with terraces and balconies, feature covered parking and golf and ocean views. Developed in 2007, these gorgeous residences are of tropical contemporary design that is as attractive as the coral pink flowers of the carao tree.

timeline_5
Jobo

2008 | Residential

These 18 condominium units, completed in 2008, feature a tropical colonial style and a wide variety of floor plans. Named after the jobo tree, also called the hog plum or yellow mombin and known for its extremely sweet fruit.

timeline_6
Llama del Bosque

2010 | Residential

At the heart of our resort, a few minutes away from Playa Conchal’s beautiful white sands, this 41 single-family homesite community features contemporary tropical design in the eight homes built since 2010. Named after the “fireball” or “flame tree,” remarkable for its striking reddish-orange flowers.

timeline_7
Cortez Amarillo

2013 | Residential

These five exclusive, high-end lots, currently featuring three completed homes, allow you to enjoy the breathtaking view oft the sunset and the ocean from a state-of-the-art tropical contemporary home. Named after the tree known for its resplendent yellow flowers.

timeline_8
Roble Sabana

2014 | Residential

Overlooking the Pacific Ocean and our Audubon-certified golf course, these 20 condominiums feature contemporary native architecture. Built in 2015, they offer floor plans of 1, 2 or 3 bedrooms, with expansive balcony views and private common areas with swimming pool. Named after an ornamental tree remarkable for its pastel pink and maroon flowers.

timeline_9
Aromo

2016 | Residential

The contemporary design of Aromo brings the experience of high-end living to a whole new level. Integrated in its 6 townhomes spanning across 3 homesites, every thought-out detail was designed to improve daily life. From the perfect location —10 minutes from the beach club and Playa Conchal’s white sand beaches— to the suitability of the grand sliding doors leading to the house’s garden and private plunge pool; every feature calls for enjoyment.

timeline_10
Cocobolo

2020 | Residential

Cocobolo hovers gracefully above the soothing community of Reserva Conchal. At the highest point, we consider all comforts. Built in 2020, Cocobolo harmonizes the luxuries of city living with the indescribable beauty of nature’s all-encompassing embrace. This impressive development of 5 lots takes its name from a distinctive tree that imparts a natural-proof polish.

timeline_11
W Residences Costa Rica

2021 | Residential

This 14 residence collection sets the new standard in extraordinary, hotel inspired living, where ownership perks are second to none. Indulge yourself every day.

timeline_12
Ceibo

2021 | Residential

Ceibo is a distinctive community comprising 10 homesites that redefine what it means to live at the heart of a paradisiacal community. At Ceibo, life feels intimately intertwined with all the excitement that Reserva Conchal has to offer.

timeline_13
Sauco

2022 | Residential

17 secluded homesites nestled amidst nature’s beauty. These homesites, surrounded by majestic trees, invite residents to join a vibrant community where nature thrives.

timeline_14
Guayacán Real

2023 | Residential

10 majestic ocean view homesites. An elevated living experience in every sense; become immersed in nature, feel the gentle mountain breeze, and be awed by the expansive views of the Pacific Ocean at Reserva Conchal.

timeline_15
Solaris

2024 | Residential

Expected to finish in 2024, these 42 high-end residencies within the breathtaking property of this natural reserve become one with stunning views of turquoise waters and the white sands.

timeline_16
Sanara

2024 | Residential

Sanara is a sustainable community that seamlessly
combines luxury living with contemporary design. Sanara Phase I will feature 30 tropical contemporary residences. The spacious lots range from 1,620 m2 to 2,375 m2, offering unprecedented forest views and ample living areas.
